description: In the fixed ambient model universe, a finite set \(E\) of positive ground equations entails a finite disjunction of ground equalities if and only if it entails at least one disjunct. The empty disjunction is falsity.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.equality_convexity.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L))
  (ps : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) :
  (∀ (M : Type u) (inst : L.Structure M),
      Nonempty M →
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.EquationsHold E M →
          M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.equationDisjunction ps) ↔
    ∃ p ∈ ps, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.EquationConsequence E p
